infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location helps identify where an item was lost or found on campus.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Injibara Campus Lost & Found to access your photos so you can upload pictures of lost and found items.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Injibara Campus Lost & Found to use your camera to photograph lost and found items.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Injibara Campus Lost & Found to access your location to identify where an item was lost or found.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Allow Injibara Campus Lost & Found to use Face ID for secure authentication.
